# Autumn & Wool

> Autumn & Wool is a small knitwear studio in Riga, Latvia, run by designer and maker Kristine. It makes women's wool cardigans, sweaters, sweater vests, beanies and scarves from merino wool, lambswool and pure new wool. Pieces are knitted by hand or on a manually operated knitting machine, then hand-sewn, washed and pressed before shipping. Before launching autumnandwool.com, the same maker sold as Mareshop on Etsy (since 2011).

## Key facts
- Brand: Autumn & Wool (formerly Mareshop on Etsy). Company: AUTUMN AND WOOL, SIA, reg. no. 40203644965.
- Studio address: Braslas iela 22d, Rīga, LV-1035, Latvia. Email: autumnandwool@gmail.com. Instagram: @autumnandwool.
- Materials: merino wool, lambswool or pure new wool; the exact fibre is listed on each product page.
- Sizes: S–XL (EU 36–42, UK 8–14, US 6–12); many oversized pieces are one size. Size guide: https://www.autumnandwool.com/size-guide
- Shipping: free to Latvia, the United States and other destinations shown at checkout. In-stock items leave Riga in 2–5 working days; estimated delivery 5–10 working days in Europe and 7–20 days to the USA, Canada and Australia.
- Returns: within 14 days of delivery for items in original condition; exchanges for another size or colour subject to stock. Details: https://www.autumnandwool.com/shipping-returns
- Prices in EUR. Payment by card at a secure checkout.

## Care
Hand wash cold with a wool-safe detergent, do not tumble dry, lay flat to dry, store folded with cedar or lavender.
